The '''Skirmish at Kriselist''' was one of the first engagements of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Prelude==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Nantz]] was given command of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]], tasked with operations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. He staged his campaign from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] after the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==The skirmish==
During the skirmish, the New Republic deployed [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] in one of the shattered urban centers of [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]] to find [[Utoxx Prentioch]]'s hidden palace. The New Republic overcame Prentioch's army, consisting of little more than thugs and cutthroats, and freed Kriselist from his tyrannical and brutal rule.<ref name="RES" />

==Aftermath==
After his victory against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] Prentioch's forces at Kriselist, Nantz then bypassed the rest of Prentioch's [[Prentioch's Dominion|territory]] to [[Seizure of Moorja|engage]] [[Sander Delvardus|Delvardus's]] forces at [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
